description: Extract structured data from Facebook pages — either provide direct page URLs, or discover pages by keyword and location. Provide session cookies for the most reliable discovery and full contact/business details.

cookies.description: Facebook session cookies. STRONGLY RECOMMENDED — without valid cookies, Facebook blocks ~94% of discovered pages with a login wall, most contact/business fields (phone, email, address, hours) will be empty, and page discovery itself is far less reliable. Accepts EITHER (1) a JSON array of Playwright-style cookie objects, OR (2) a raw `name=value; name2=value2` Cookie header string. Required cookies: c_user, xs, datr, fr, sb. Export them from your logged-in Facebook session via browser DevTools (Application > Cookies > facebook.com). Example: [{"name":"c_user","value":"1000...","domain":".facebook.com","path":"/"}]
cookies.sectionDescription: Facebook session cookies are strongly recommended. Without them, most pages return a login wall and contact/business fields will be missing. The scraper always uses residential IPs — providing cookies from any browser session will work.
cookies.title: Facebook Session Cookies

includeReviews.description: Fetch and include real reviews (reviewer name, recommend/don't-recommend verdict, review text, date) for each page, when available. Adds one extra request per page. Disable for faster/cheaper runs if you don't need reviews.
includeReviews.title: Include Reviews

locations.description: Optional locations to combine with each search term for location-aware discovery. For example, adding 'London' will search for 'Coffee Shop London'.
locations.title: Locations

maxItems.description: Maximum number of page rows to output. For 500–1000+ results, provide Facebook session cookies and use multiple search terms or locations to maximize discovery. Also scales SERP pagination depth automatically.
maxItems.title: Maximum Items

searchTerms.description: Search terms for page discovery. Each term is combined with each location (if provided) to find matching Facebook pages. Either searchTerms or startUrls is required.
searchTerms.title: Search Terms

startUrls.description: Direct list of Facebook page URLs to scrape (skips keyword/location discovery entirely for these). Accepts full page URLs, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/McDonalds. Can be combined with searchTerms — results from both are merged. Either startUrls or searchTerms is required.

url.description: URL of a Facebook page to scrape, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/McDonalds
url.title: URL of a Facebook page

startUrls.title: Facebook Page URLs

title: Facebook Pages Scraper Input
